hook: An update reminder is a security reminder.
action: Install updates through built-in settings or official stores.
caveat: Avoid unexpected update links in messages.

hook: One copy is one point of failure.
action: Keep a second recoverable copy of important files.
caveat: Sync may also replicate deletions; test restoration.
cta: Back up one important folder today.

hook: Does that app really need access?
action: Grant only permissions needed for the feature.
caveat: Menu names vary by device and OS version.

hook: Free Wi-Fi is not automatically trustworthy.
action: Confirm the network name with the venue.
caveat: A VPN does not make phishing sites safe.

action: Inspect the actual domain before signing in.
caveat: HTTPS does not prove a site is genuine.
cta: Use the official app or known address.
